'''Lizil''' was the name of a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive living in an [[Lizil|asteroid]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It's members were about waist height in comparison to a [[Human/Legends|Human]].

==History==
[[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] as well as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] first encountered this [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive in their [[Lizil|asteroid]] when they were searching for the members of the [[Myrkr strike team]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

Later, the Solos encountered the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] [[Grees]], [[Sligh]], and [[Emala]] selling weapons to the Lizil in their hive.
